title: System configuration change
description: A change to the system wide configuration.

type.description: Type of the configuration changed. It is assumed that there are many instances per type. For example user roles.

name.description: Name of the configuration instance changed. For example user role name.

attributes.description: Attributes set as a result of the change. This includes both modified and not modified attributes

previous_data.description: Previous values of attributes which were modified.
